svg.title: JDBC Caffeine Local Cache Architecture
svg.desc: JDBC Caffeine architecture rebuilt from exposed-jdbc-caffeine README, AbstractJdbcCaffeineRepository, AbstractSuspendedJdbcCaffeineRepository, JdbcCacheRepository, and LocalCacheConfig source.
svg.text: Sync and suspend JDBC repositories wrap Exposed table access with an in-process Caffeine cache; Redis is not part of this module.

g.text: This architecture view shows local cache ownership and JDBC transaction boundaries, not a class hierarchy.
Caffeine is in-process only; write-behind uses a bounded Channel and background batch flush.
